title: Vinegar fabric softener
subtitle: A rinse-cycle softener with lavender
excerpt: White vinegar with lavender essential oil added to the rinse compartment of the washing machine. Removes soap residue from fabrics, reduces static, and leaves a faint lavender scent. Makes 500 ml.
sourceNotes: Acetic acid as rinse aid and soap-residue remover: open-access fabric care references. Essential oil stability in vinegar: general cosmetic chemistry literature.

recipe.yieldDescription: ~500 ml softener (roughly 25 loads at 20 ml per load)
recipe.batchNotes: Make 1 litre at a time; halve the essential oil if you prefer a lighter scent.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Mix a 500 ml bottle and keep it by the machine. Stable for a year.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps one year in a sealed bottle. The lavender essential oil fades after four to six months; the vinegar action remains. Discard if the liquid turns cloudy or smells sharp and unclean.

glossaryTerms.definition: Acetic acid in the rinse cycle neutralises any alkaline detergent left in the fabric after the wash, reducing stiffness and preventing the white powdery residue that hard water and strong detergents can leave.

content.text: This is white vinegar with lavender essential oil, used in the rinse-aid compartment of the washing machine. The

of the acetic acid neutralises detergent residue in the fabric, leaving towels softer and shirts less stiff. The lavender scent is light; it fades on the fabric as it dries. The vinegar smell dissipates entirely in the machine.

items.prepNote: approximately 2 ml; for a light scent in the wash

content.text: Pour the white vinegar into a bottle with a cap.
Add the lavender essential oil drops. Cap and shake gently.
Shake before each use as the essential oil will float to the top between uses. Add 20 ml (4 teaspoons) to the rinse-aid or fabric-softener compartment before each wash. Do not add to the main drum.

Safe with all standard washing machine types including HE (high-efficiency) front-loaders. The vinegar will gradually dissolve limescale in the machine drum and door seal, which is beneficial. Do not use with bleach-based detergents in the same wash; the two interact to produce chlorine gas.
Keeps one year in a sealed bottle. Store in the laundry cupboard at room temperature.
